kpvee01.title: Venus to Aries: The Date-Three Flash Mob
kpvee01.caption: Aries had the banner up by date three. Venus had notes. Grand gestures are gorgeous, just maybe after you know their middle name. Who in your group chat is already holding the banner?

kpvee03.title: Venus to Gemini: Forty Memes, No Words
kpvee03.caption: Forty memes sent. Zero feelings stated. Venus says memes are a dialect, but the crush was waiting for three words. Tag the friend who flirts exclusively in frogs on scooters.

kpvee05.title: Venus to Leo: Compliment Them First
kpvee05.caption: Leo had a whole list of compliments ready. All about Leo. Venus flipped the card, and somehow Leo glowed brighter. Which sign would rehearse in the mirror first?
